source.enable_note: U3 enable (EN/U3.5) is tied to +15V; no separate enable net

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Read native pad geometry, copper, physical connectivity, constraints and findings. Coordinates are mm; x right, y down.

tools.name: place
tools.description: Move one functional footprint (U3, L2, C9-C13, R16, R17) to x_mm/y_mm with orientation 0, 90, 180 or 270. Terminals never move. Copper stays in place. Thirty total edits.

tools.name: route
tools.description: Replace one net's tracks and vias with exactly this polyline of 2-12 explicit vertices on the named copper layer. No snapping or routing search. Thirty total edits.

tools.name: remove_route
tools.description: Remove all tracks and vias for the selected net. Counts as one edit.

tools.name: add_via
tools.description: Add one 0.8/0.4 mm via on the selected net at explicit coordinates. Counts as one edit.

tools.name: add_zone
tools.description: Add one copper pour polygon on the selected net and layer; KiCad fills it. Supply every vertex. Counts as one edit.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Reload and check physical connectivity, full applicable KiCad DRC, placement, protected state and buck layout rules. Finish only after this returns pass.
